evs.evidence:
CreateNPCTrainerParty 0x9C7008-0x9C7CDA writes EVs in three places, all after CreateMon 0x803DA54 zeroes the member through ZeroMonData 0x803D994.
EV bytes sit unencrypted at mon+56..61 in HP, Attack, Defense, Speed, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def order, with substruct at +32 and EVs at +24.
Write (1) is the spread copy at 0x9C754C-0x9C7566, which stores spread row bytes +2..+7.
The selected spread is the stored low byte or the rival selector shared with trainers.ivs.
The copy requires a spread in 1-141 at 0x9C752E-0x9C7538 and difficulty other than Vanilla at 0x9C753C-0x9C7540.
Zero rows are copied as zeros.
Write stage (2) is trainer adjustment routine 0xA11514, whose hash is in trainers.ivs and which runs only for spreads 1-141.
Every EV write in the adjustment routine is declared in the profile.
A path-sensitive walk of all 1063 return paths accounts for each strb/strh/str into mon+56..61, each SetMonData field 26-31 and each ClearAllEvs 0xA10424 call.
The HP-parity loops at 0xA11DCE and 0xA12070 move 4 HP EVs to Defense until maximum HP at mon+88, after CalculateMonStats 0x89C4474, is even.
Members removed by ZeroMonData in that routine are the ability overrides marked absent.
Write (3) at 0x9C7B92-0x9C7C26 applies to every member when grant predicate 0xA10698 (difficulty, class, location) and GetMonEVCount 0x8043A40 == 0 hold.
It gives 252 EVs to the two highest base stats from 0xA140CE.
HP and Attack seed the pair with Attack first on a tie.
Defense through Sp. Def displace them only when strictly higher.
The rebalanced variant at 0x9E6EEC uses flag 0x16E2, or facility flag 0x9F0 with tier 11.
For species that cannot evolve and are not 303, the non-HP stats compare as min(255, stat * (600 - HP) / (total - HP)).
The evolution checks at 0xA140A8 and 0xA13DEC look for a method other than 0, 253 or 254 before the terminator.
The predicate reads the player's location word at gSaveBlock1Ptr+4 and GetCurrentRegionMapSectionId 0x8056260.
A trainer's location is its decoded battle map.
No later routine of the party setup 0x89C7EBC writes EVs.
Native evidence covers 27,161 members of 9,216 synthetic direct party-builder calls on the original ROM.
The calls cover all trainers, four difficulties, flags 0x821, 0x16E2, 0x82C, 0x170B and 0x9F3, places 14.3, 14.15, 36.10, 2.49, 10.25 and 1.79, and the partner side.
The members match this pipeline evaluated on the native species, level, item and IVs.

Treat the ROM as authoritative.

The routine dispatches trainer 651 at 0xA116D8 without a difficulty test.

Pignite (552) above level 35 is rewritten at 0xA120EE with one word to species 553 and held item 176.
Its move slot 3 becomes Earthquake (89) through 0x89F7208, its Speed EV becomes 252 at 0xA120FE, and its nickname becomes the new species name.
Alolan Grimer (1034) above level 37 is rewritten at 0xA12130 to species 1035 with held item 494 and the new name.
The built level is the listed level after the level scaling of 0x9C3BD0 or 0x9C32EC, so the result depends on the player's party and badges.

Level-scaling evolution through 0x8A13E84, called at 0x9C330E and 0x9C3C88, is a separate mechanism enabled only for opponents in trainer battle modes 5, 7 and 13-16 (0x9C71D6-0x9C71FA).
